pwa.title: Install the app
pwa.description: Open your club from your device’s home screen.
pwa.ios: In Safari, open the share menu and choose “Add to Home Screen”. If “Open as Web App” appears, turn it on and confirm with “Add”.
pwa.browser: Open your browser’s menu and look for “Install app” or “Add to Home Screen”. If neither appears, try Chrome, Edge or Safari.
pwa.connection: An internet connection is needed to view your data and manage bookings.
